meta.name: task-clarifier
meta.description: Deep need-clarification skill. Activates only on explicit invocation: direct reference to $task-clarifier, or trigger phrases "帮我理清需求" / "需求澄清" / "clarify" / "clarify my needs" / "help me clarify". Once activated, keeps asking until all three goals are met: the user fully understands their own needs, the AI fully understands the user's needs, and the user confirms the AI's understanding is correct. Does not auto-activate; does not intervene in task execution unless explicitly invoked.

copy.tagline: 帮你理清模糊需求，直到双方确认无误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在任务开始后才发现需求理解有偏差。
